sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shiv Kant Mishra,Kamlesh Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Anjali Upadhya Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
The petitioners herein who are 62 in number are tenure holders claimed to be tenure holders of different Khasras (Gatas) located in village Thapkhera, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar which are being acquired by acquisition notification dated 23.07.2009 and 16.03.2010 under Section 4(1) and Section 6 of Land Acquisition Act; respectively.

From the averments made in the writ petition, it is evident that the petitioners herein are successors of the original tenure holders who were owners in occupation of the land in question at the time of acquisition.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 It is admitted fact of the matter that all the tenure holders namely the predecessors in interest of the petitioners had taken compensation under the award prepared in accordance with Section 11(2) of the Land Acquisition Act under Karar Niyamavali, 1997.

The present writ petition filed with a relief to quash the notification on the premise of violation of provisions of Section 5-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, for denial of opportunity, without any sufficient material before the State Government, is nothing but misuse of the process of the Court.
We therefore, dismiss the present writ petition with a cost of ?6,200/- which shall be deposited within a period of two weeks before the Registrar General, High Court, Allahabad.
The cost so deposited shall be transmitted to the account of High Court Legal Services Committee.
It is open for the petitioners to distribute the total amount of the cost amongst themselves equally.
